findings.title: Vendored audit prompt packs are stale and the run manifest references a prompt the pack does not contain
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: residual unchanged. prompts/repo-deep-dive/prompts/ still ends at 40_release_notes_changelog_generator.md (43 files incl. 00_SHARED and MASTER_RUNNER; prompts 41-45 absent); prompts/repo-deep-dive/RUN_ORDER.md:43 ends at prompt 40; committed run manifests still list 45_exploit_chain_attack_path_audit (docs/audits/repo-deep-dive/mainecybertech-20261004-full-main-9c0b88c/audit_manifest.json and .../mainecybertech-20261011-0426-full-main-8d299b8/audit_manifest.json, scope.domains); no pack README carries a pinned-version/source banner (prompts/repo-deep-dive/README.md has none); no guard resolves manifest entries or pack-README script paths to vendored files. The drift is only documented centrally (prompts/PROVENANCE.md).

findings.title: `AGENTS.md` names a stale repository path and three developer docs state a stale accessibility gate size that no guard covers
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: AGENTS.md:3 names github.com/MaineCyberTech/mainecybertech; docs/testing.md:66,125, docs/WEB_UI_CONVENTIONS.md:104 and docs/CI.md:13 state the 25-route gate (68 with A11Y_FULL); scripts/check-docs-counts.mjs:630-660 asserts those docs against the BASE_PAGES/FULL_PAGES arrays in apps/web/e2e/a11y.spec.ts and runs in the shared unit-tests action (.github/actions/unit-tests/action.yml:47-56) used by PR and deploy pipelines.

findings.title: No machine-enforced agent guardrails: allowed paths, human-approval actions, and small-batch PR limits exist only as prose
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: two of the four recommendations landed - verify-prompts.js verify now runs in the shared PR/deploy test job (.github/actions/unit-tests/action.yml:168-174, validate.yml:148 keeps the deploy gate) and CODEOWNERS has explicit owners for .github/, supabase/migrations/, infra/ and docs (.github/CODEOWNERS:30-50). Residual: still no PR-size guard (grep changed_files|pr-size|max-files|net-lines across .github/ and scripts/ returns nothing); no committed-docs/openapi.yaml regenerate-and-diff step (scripts/openapi-audit.js compares code routes to spec.ts only); agent path boundaries remain CODEOWNERS review routing, not an allowlist.

findings.title: Prompt packs embed generated outputs alongside instructions without a machine-detectable not-instructions marker
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: the central banner is intact (prompts/PROVENANCE.md:3-9; AGENTS.md:74-76; .continue/agents/config.yaml:32), but the marker is still not per-pack or machine-detectable: grep -rli 'not instructions' under prompts/ matches only PROVENANCE.md and repo-deep-dive/prompts/00_SHARED_AUDIT_RULES.md; no pack README carries it; scripts/verify-prompts.js only hashes files (no marker/classification check). Embedded outputs (engine/outputs, Run1/Run2) remain unlabelled per file.

findings.title: `.continue/` agent configuration defines models only and does not surface project rules or boundaries
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: .continue/agents/config.yaml:23-33 restates 7 project rules including 'AGENTS.md is the agent contract', generated-file/migration do-not-touch rules, no-secret and prompts/-is-data rules. Residual: hand-maintained duplicate of AGENTS.md with no drift check (recommendation only).

findings.title: Embedded repo maps and historical pack outputs still reference the pre-rename repository path
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: 'mainecybertech-portal' still appears 52 times across 30 tracked files (17 under prompts/); docs/ONBOARDING.md:37 - the one live-doc hit named in the recommendation - still roots the monorepo tree at 'mainecybertech-portal/'. docs/GAP_ANALYSIS.md and docs/audits/repo-deep-dive/REAUDIT_REPORT_20261004.md are now clean (fixed since 8d299b8).

findings.title: `AGENTS.md` retains a large self-contradicting snapshot history that an agent must disambiguate
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: AGENTS.md is 407 lines / 36 KB (was 1,003 lines / 120 KB); the dated ledgers, snapshot narratives and Audit Reports table moved to docs/HISTORY.md (669 lines) behind an explicit historical-data banner (docs/HISTORY.md:1-15); AGENTS.md:390-393 points at it; review.md mirror is 413 lines and guarded by sync-review-md --check (action.yml:164-166).

findings.title: Secrets guidance is spread across instructions without a linked canonical runbook
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: docs/SECRETS_ROTATION.md is linked from the AGENTS.md approval list (AGENTS.md:61) and Never list (AGENTS.md:85), from CONTRIBUTING.md:59 and from the PR-template secrets item (.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md:24).

findings.title: Committed audit corpus under docs/audits/ is outside the untrusted-data boundary and has no integrity pin
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: AGENTS.md:91-95 extends the Never list to docs/audits/** and docs/HISTORY.md with the unpinned-data rationale; docs/audits/README.md:1-11 carries the untrusted-data banner and states the corpus is intentionally unpinned because it is data. Residual: no integrity pin by explicit decision (accepted risk).

findings.title: Audit output conventions in docs/audits/README.md are stale vs the committed runs
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: docs/audits/README.md:13-70 documents the canonical repo-deep-dive run contract (required finals, manifest keys, status vocabulary including partially-fixed/regressed), :75-99 documents the legacy manual packs, and the Runs table lists every committed run including the pack-level re-audit report (labelled report, not a run directory).

findings.title: Prompt-pack provenance verification runs only at the deploy gate, not on PRs
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: .github/actions/unit-tests/action.yml:168-174 runs node scripts/verify-prompts.js verify in the shared unit-tests action consumed by test.yml:44 (PRs) and validate.yml (deploy gate), so a prompts/ change is caught before merge with the deploy gate as defence in depth.

findings.title: No AI-authorship disclosure or provenance policy in contribution guidance
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: the PR template has an 'AI assistance (optional)' section naming the tool/model and human owner plus 'Agents must not self-approve or merge' (.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md:5-8); AGENTS.md:65-70 and CONTRIBUTING.md:50 state the disclosure expectation.

findings.title: AGENTS.md Known Debt carries a stale promotion binding and a now-false branch-direction claim
findings.note: NEW at 7dd0402. AGENTS.md:124 - in the file agents are told is the only contract - still says 'the last promotion was PR #168 (main @ 8d299b8d, 2026-10-11) and develop carries later commits'. At 7dd0402 main has been promoted twice since (9ba108b5, 7dd04023) and is 7 commits ahead of origin/develop (adea7fe5 is an ancestor), so both the binding and the direction are wrong. The same stale text exists in docs/RELEASING.md:183-186 (REL-P2-005; dedupe candidate). Impact: an agent reading Known Debt gets a false picture of what is on main. Recommendation: drop the hard-coded binding/direction and rely on the compare instruction already present, or refresh it at each promotion.
